PowerShell($keys = @{}; foreach \($f in 'en','hi','gu','ta','te'\) { try { $d = Get-Content "data/i18n/$f.json" -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $flat = @\(\); function Walk\($o,$p\){ foreach\($pr in $o.PSObject.Properties\){ if\($pr.Value -is [PSCustomObject]\){ Walk $pr.Value "$p$\($pr.Name\)." } else { $script:flat += "$p$\($pr.Name\)" } } }; $script:flat=@\(\); Walk $d ''; $keys[$f]=$script:flat; Write-Output "$f : valid JSON, $\($script:flat.Count\) leaf keys" } catch { Write-Output "$f : INVALID - $_" } }; $ref=$keys['en']; foreach\($f in 'hi','gu','ta','te'\){ $missing = $ref | Where-Object { $keys[$f] -notcontains $_ }; $extra = $keys[$f] | Where-Object { $ref -notcontains $_ }; Write-Output "$f vs en -> missing: $\($missing -join ','\) | extra: $\($extra -join ','\)" })
